newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to pay $827 mln to Paris Club members in 97.
newsitem.headline: Manila to pay $827 mln to Paris Club members in 97.

text.p: The Philippines is set to amortise about $827 million of its debts to Paris Club creditors this year, the finance department said on Friday.
"The total principal repayments are projected to be around $651 million while interest is expected to reach $176 million," the department said in a statement.
Outstanding obligations to Paris Club members, which are mostly foreign governments and their donor agencies, were at $3.179 billion as of end of last year as against $3.967 billion in 1995.
The Japanese government has the biggest exposure of $1.76 billion, while the United States has $629 million.
